categories.main_business_segments: Tianneng Power International Limited primarily operates in two segments: manufacturing and trading. The manufacturing segment focuses on lead-acid batteries, lithium-ion batteries, hydrogen fuel cells, sodium-ion batteries, and solid-state batteries, serving applications such as light electric vehicles, automotive starter batteries, energy storage systems (ESS), and special industrial vehicles. The trading segment involves trading of materials related to battery production and recycling.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including lead-acid battery lifecycle management, lead-carbon battery technology, lithium-ion battery systems, hydrogen fuel cells, sodium-ion batteries, and solid-state batteries. It integrates smart manufacturing, digital transformation with 5G, IoT, and AI, and has developed proprietary battery management systems (BMS) and energy management systems (EMS). Recycling technologies include advanced hydrometallurgy, pyrolysis enrichment, and intelligent sorting for battery materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tianneng serves customers in the light electric vehicle market, automotive industry (starter and start-stop batteries), telecommunications (UPS systems), industrial and special vehicles, energy storage sectors, and emerging markets such as hydrogen fuel cell applications. Its customers include distributors, end-users of electric bicycles and vehicles, communication base operators, and industrial clients requiring energy storage solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant expansion in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, Indonesia, and Cambodia. It is also developing presence in Europe, the Americas, and other international markets through localized production and sales operations, representative offices, and participation in global exhibitions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianneng operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the battery supply chain, including R&D, manufacturing, sales, and recycling of battery products. It manages the full lifecycle of batteries, from production to recycling and reuse, establishing a closed-loop circular economy within the battery industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in lead-acid, lithium-ion, hydrogen fuel cells, sodium-ion, and solid-state batteries. It focuses on smart manufacturing, digital transformation, and green development. R&D efforts target improving battery performance, safety, lifespan, and cost reduction, alongside advancing recycling technologies and expanding energy storage and new energy applications.
categories.revenue_model: Tianneng generates revenue primarily through product sales of batteries and related energy storage systems. It also earns income from trading materials and recycling services. The company engages in project EPC contracting and system integration for energy storage projects, and provides customized solutions to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tianneng is a leading player in the new energy battery industry in China, especially in lead-acid batteries for light electric vehicles. It holds a strong market position supported by technological innovation and a comprehensive battery lifecycle ecosystem. The report does not specify named competitors but highlights Tianneng's leadership and competitive advantages in technology and market reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tianneng reported revenue of approximately RMB76.7 billion, with profit attributable to owners of RMB1.14 billion. The company experienced a revenue decline of 8.61% and a profit decrease of 37.29% compared to 2023. Total assets increased to RMB55.3 billion, reflecting ongoing capital investments. The company maintains a strong financial position with a net cash surplus and a gearing ratio of 33.55%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianneng emphasizes innovation-driven, high-quality, and eco-friendly battery products with enhanced performance, safety, and lifecycle. Its value proposition includes comprehensive lifecycle management, advanced recycling technologies, smart manufacturing, and customized energy solutions. The company differentiates itself through integration of multiple battery technologies, digital empowerment, and a global expansion strategy aimed at sustainable development and circular economy leadership.
